text_block_list.text: ——The next day.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Hoi hoi! Aight, pump up more balloons～!
Fill the whole room!

text_block_list.name: Committee Uma Musume A
text_block_list.text:
Should we hang a mirror ball here?
It'll totally flip the vibe,
might get crazy hype... is that okay?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Totally Gucci!
We're making this the hypest dance in
history!
Mirror balls are loud and super flashy,
pure dope vibes～～!

text_block_list.name: Committee Uma Musume A
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha! Yeah,
it's hella flashy! And super fresh...!
Everyone's gonna be blown away,
they'll love it!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Fr fr?! Let's blast even more lasers!
Gotta drop a plan that gets everyone turnt
up!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: What about, like, Karaoke Dance Time?!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Drop some live beats～,
just step forward ♪ Follow
your heart ♪ and spin! Boom, like that!

text_block_list.name: Committee Uma Musume B
text_block_list.text: Pair dancing with live vocals...?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Yup! And soooomeday ♪ I'll surpass even
myseeeelf ♪
Yo, Zephachi, hop on this beat～!

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Twirl～♪ Hehe～ This breeze feels quite
favorable.

text_block_list.name: Committee Uma Musume B
text_block_list.text: Ahaha～ awesome, that looks so fun!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Helios truly pours her spirit into song!
A mid-performance mic drop could be
fantastic!

text_block_list.name: Committee Uma Musume A
text_block_list.text:
All right, let's expand the playlist!
Not just classic waltzes,
but some hype bangers too!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Say less! Let's make this stage pop off!
Wanna add more neon colors?

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Would you like to feel the wind more deeply?
Bringing
the stage outdoors... would let us dance free,
like blossoms riding the gale.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Yoooo,
let's goooo～～! We are so doing that!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Yo Mira! Got any fire ideas to add?!

text_block_list.name: K.S.Miracle
text_block_list.text:
I... I think everyone's ideas are lovely.
For now, I will consult
the student council regarding moving the
stage outside.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Oh, you're a lifesaver!
But make sure you have fun too, Mira!
Not just chores! What do YOU wanna do?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Like Karaoke Dance Time, y'know?
If anything pops in your head,
just go wild ☆

text_block_list.name: K.S.Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Thank you.
If inspiration strikes,
I will let you know.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Drop your song requests, peeps～!
We cookin' a straight fire playlist!

text_block_list.name: Committee Members
text_block_list.text: WEEEII～～!

text_block_list.name: K.S.Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Ah, I'll go fetch some refreshments.
It has grown quite warm today.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Wha? Absolute saint～ sparkling water for me,
pretty please ♡

text_block_list.name: K.S.Miracle
text_block_list.text:
(Fufu. Helios-san is truly wonderful.
She is always
enjoying herself, honest,
and boundless as the sky——)

text_block_list.name: K.S.Miracle
text_block_list.text:
(———Having fun,
is it. I am content just seeing others
happy,
but... I wonder if that is wrong...)

text_block_list.name: K.S.Miracle
text_block_list.text:
(Should I... enjoy myself together with them...
too...?)
——A few days later.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: ALL DONEEE!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Decorations ready!
Karaoke Dance Time playlist locked in!
Sound and lighting green across the board!
Everything is flawless!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Now for the dress rehearsal... but first,
Helios, you must invite Ruby-san!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Mega facts～～! I'm on it～～!
Calling My Lady right now!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: I wish you the best of luck!

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
(——It is still insufficient.
I remain...
far beneath the elegance of Mother's
dance.)

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
(——Mother, in that recording...
your presence was breathtakingly radiant
and commanding.)

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
(To attain that supreme pinnacle...
something crucial is lacking.
If I cannot discover it, I............)

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: MY PRINCESS～～～～!

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: —Do you require something?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: An invite! Right here!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
About the date, it's my big comeback! 
For real this time!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
For real, I thought about it super hard! 
How do I get you Best Date? And it hit me!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
I wanna show you! 
I know you'll say yes!

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: ...Understood. I accept your invitation.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: —!! OMG, mega hype!!
